name: abap2ui5-agent
description: Every abap2UI5 app is agent-operable - an ABAP-native MCP endpoint that lets AI agents read and operate abap2UI5 apps as the real SAP user - plus AI at runtime: generative UI and an in-app copilot.

scripts.syfixes: find src -type f -name '*.abap' -exec sed -i -e 's/ RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found/ ASSERT 1 = 0/g' {} +
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run lint:cloud && npm run check:abap2ui5 && npm run genui:check && npm run check:version && npm run rename
scripts.auto_downport: rm -rf src/04 && (abaplint --fix .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc || true) && npm run syfixes && npm run strip_trailing_ws && abaplint .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc && cp -f .github/abaplint/abap_702.jsonc abaplint.jsonc && npm run abaplintpathfix
